[P2] Parse externally supplied stack traces defensively

Invoke failures can originate from standard Lambdas or other language SDKs, so `ErrorObject.stackTrace()` is not guaranteed to use Java's `class|method|file|line` format. `deserializeStackTrace` throws on foreign or malformed entries, preventing `InvokeFailedException` from reaching user recovery code; `CallbackException` now has the same issue for caller-supplied errors. Make reconstruction best-effort, preserving the `ErrorObject` while omitting invalid frames, and test non-Java stack strings.
